title: Model of Fort of Diu
detailed_description: Model of fort of Diu showing two different styles of fortification: (i) the usual style consisting of round bastions prevailant all over the world which was known in Europe as the old Italian style (bastions broken at places). (ii) Later, as a second belt of fortification, wall I was added in 'heco' i.e.Italian in style consisting of heart shaped bastions which contained mathematical gunfire storerooms with hidden openings in front of the rampart walls. This special fortification design was invented in Italy towards the middle of 16th century from where it had spread to all over Europe. With the advent of Portuguese, this style travelled to India. Cast-Plaster Caster Cement.
